g.text: Monorepo — resolve request tenant and workspace
Recognize sk-laplace- Bearer key; otherwise X-Api-Key with that prefix
Return invalid_key; do not fall through to browser/dev
Authenticated browser has tenant claim and GUID user claim?
Query current membership of selected workspace
Clone request principal; replace tenant claims
Store selected workspace role in request items
Delete selection cookie; retain original ticket tenant
Workspace cookie is nonempty and at most 160 characters?
Return browser tenant with user/provider claims
Return trimmed X-Laplace-Tenant or local-dev as header tenant
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Tenant resolution is not authorization. ApiKeyTenantResolver is registered in all
modes; non-header modes enforce identity in separate middleware. Workspace selection is
checked against membership and mutates only the request principal, not the immutable login
ticket. SQL membership function and browser ticket validation remain nested.
